images.caption: Figure 1:LittleCurriculumandLittleLearnerprovide a pedagogically grounded sandbox for studying model behavior under precise data constraints.LittleCurriculumis an 88B-token pretraining corpus filtered from FineWeb-Edu[28]to only contain elementary school (K–5) data. On it, we train a 5B model:LittleLearner. Together, they form a well-curated sandbox to study scaling, post-training, educational science and more.

Figure 3:LittleLearneris increasingly unfamiliar with more difficult text, as shown by increasing bits-per-byte (BPB)[56]on CLEAR[9]. Samples are binned by the pedagogical Bradley-Terry easiness score[3].
